claims: Moya Brennan was the lead singer of Clannad.
Moya Brennan passed away at her home in County Donegal, Ireland.
Moya Brennan was diagnosed with pulmonary fibrosis in 2020.
Pulmonary fibrosis is a chronic lung disease.
Moya Brennan passed away surrounded by her loved ones.
Moya Brennan was lead singer of Clannad for over 50 years.
Moya Brennan continued to perform despite her illness.
Moya Brennan concluded a farewell tour with Clannad in 2023.
